Bidder must declare that there is no vigilance/CBI or court case pending/contemplated against them at t his moment. 7. Bidder must declare that they have not been debarred by any PSU/Govt. Dept. in doing business with th em. 8. The contract period may be extended for another 6 months after completion of the contract period w.r.t. this Bid. .
